correctness.rationale: PASS: conditional uniform ordering among s old unenvied and r available schools yields p(s,r,k)=r(s)_k/(s+r)_(k+1). First choice probability r/n implies K=0; three transition cases partition mass and evolve full bivariate law. Conditional survival telescope gives E(U|history through j)=S_j/r+H_(r-1), so covariance position sum equals 1-H_n/n. Intersection each position probability (r/n)(1/r)=1; n=1 boundary correctly degenerate. Independent exact-fraction recursion n1..7 verifies unit mass, expectations, covariance; finite diagnostics not an all-n proof.
